observations: Photo 0 shows a black Sony camera held in hand with top dials and lens mounted; "SONY" and the α logo are readable on the body.
Photo 1 shows the camera with its flip-out LCD screen open; the lens barrel reads "SONY E PZ 16-50mm 1:3.5-5.6 OSS".
Photo 2 shows the same camera from another angle with the screen open; body and lens markings match photo 1.
All photos carry a watermark "POSTED ON JIJI" and "DESTINY FRANKS".

claims.evidence: The model number ZV-E10 is not readable on the camera body in any photo, and 4K capability cannot be confirmed remotely.
Photos show no obvious damage, but cleanliness is subjective and cannot be proven from images alone.
Photos cannot show whether the camera powers on, focuses, or records.

risks.risk: Camera does not power on or record video
risks.proof: Video of the camera turning on, navigating menus, and recording a short clip

risks.risk: Lens has fungus, haze, or autofocus failure
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements plus a sample photo

risks.risk: Flip screen is cracked or unresponsive
risks.proof: Video of the screen displaying settings and responding to touch

risks.risk: Battery or charger missing or dead
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger, plus video of charging

proof_requests: Video showing the camera powering on, navigating menus, and recording a short clip
Close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements
Photo showing the camera model number printed on the body
Photo of the battery and charger
response.reason: The item is identifiable from the photos as a Sony mirrorless camera with a 16-50mm lens, so it can be priced at its worst case as untested even though the seller's model claim is unproven.
